data.title: ANTB-Paired Memecoins Eligible for Ecosystem Rewards From Trading Fees
data.description: BNB Chain announced on X that launching or holding eligible ANTB-paired memecoins can qualify participants for ecosystem rewards. The pool is funded by 10% of eligible internal trading fees, with 40% allocated to qualifying developers and 60% to qualifying holders. The campaign runs Nov 20 to 27.

data.title: Bitcoin News | Bitcoin Falls to $61,300 After Anthropic’s IPO as Nasdaq Futures Slip Below 200-Day Average
data.description: Bitcoin fell to nearly $61,300 late Thursday, near its lowest level since early July, after AI company Anthropic’s shares debuted on Nasdaq and tech stocks weakened. Bitcoin traded around $61,700 on Friday, about 29% below its October high of $87,200. More than $600 million in crypto futures positions were liquidated over 24 hours. Nasdaq futures slipped 0.7% and fell below their 200-day moving average after Thursday’s 2.4% drop in the index.Anthropic Prices Above Range and Closes 17% Higher on DebutAnthropic listed on Nasdaq on November 19 under the ticker ANT. It priced shares at $83, above its $70–$78 range, and raised about $81.3 billion in the offering. Including a $26 billion private placement, the total comes to $107.3 billion. The shares opened at $111.50, 34.3% above the IPO price, and closed their first day at $97.17, up 17.1% (calculated).Crypto Liquidations Top $600 MillionMost major cryptocurrencies fell with bitcoin, including ether, XRP and SOL. Ether traded near $1,748. Nearly half of the $600 million-plus in liquidations came in the last 12 hours, suggesting a rapid unwind of leveraged positions amid the volatility around the IPO.Analysts Split on Whether Capital Will Rotate Back to CryptoSome market participants expect money to flow back into digital assets now that the IPO is done, a view that has persisted through bitcoin’s recent slide.“My sense is that, with the Anthropic IPO now in the rear-view mirror, we could start to see capital rotating back into crypto as Bitcoin tests lower price levels, potentially below $62,000, in the coming weeks,” said Paul Howard, senior director at crypto market maker Wincent. “Rather than expecting a sharp rebound, I would anticipate a more orderly recovery over the winter months, as institutional capital gradually returns and investors look to rebuild exposure at more attractive valuations.”Others warned that continued risk aversion in tech stocks could drag bitcoin lower.“Bitcoin is unlikely to be insulated from a broader reduction in risk appetite,” said Ryan Kirkley, co-founder and CEO of settlement infrastructure firm Global Settlement Network. “When institutions reduce exposure to technology equities, crypto can face similar selling pressure because both remain sensitive to liquidity conditions.”Kirkley added that concerns about AI financing could lead investors to cut leverage and move into more defensive positions, bringing more volatility for digital assets.Long-Term Case Shifts Toward Settlement and TokenizationKirkley said short-term price swings do not weaken the long-term case for blockchain infrastructure. He said the next phase of institutional adoption will depend less on speculative valuations and more on measurable improvements in how capital moves.“Stablecoins, tokenised assets and real-time settlement infrastructure have an opportunity to demonstrate value by reducing friction, improving liquidity management and making financial transactions more efficient,” he said.

data.title: A24’s Box Office Success Could Give HBO Max a Streaming Edge
data.description: According to CNBC, A24 generated more than $526 million at the domestic box office this year as of Nov. 15, roughly $290 million—or more than 50%—above its total for all of 2025. Under a licensing deal renewed in January, HBO Max subscribers in the U.S. can stream new A24 films for a limited period after their theatrical runs. When “Backrooms” began streaming on HBO Max, it was the platform’s most-streamed title for two weeks and drew 226 million minutes of viewing time in its premiere week.

data.title: Societe Generale: UK 10-Year Gilt Yield Seen at 5.05% in 2027
data.description: According to Jin10, Societe Generale expects the UK's 10-year government bond yield to be 5.05% in 2027.

data.title: India's Torrent Power Readies Third Bond Sale This Year, Seeking Up to 20 Billion Rupees
data.description: According to Bloomberg, Torrent Power Ltd. is preparing to raise as much as 20 billion rupees ($215 million) through a rupee-denominated bond sale as early as next week, according to people familiar with the matter. It would be the Indian utility's third debt offering this year.

data.title: China Posts Rare Budget Surplus as Offshore Tax Scrutiny Lifts Receipts
data.description: According to Bloomberg, China’s budget moved into a rare surplus in October as tighter scrutiny of offshore wealth generated a one-time boost in individual income tax receipts, offsetting a long-awaited increase in fiscal spending.

data.title: AI | Morgan Stanley Says Telecoms Are Adopting Muse-Style AI to Compete
data.description: Phone and internet providers are beginning to use AI agents to compete for a promising consumer market also targeted by Meta Platforms Inc., according to Morgan Stanley, Bloomberg reported.

data.title: STOCKS | Worldline Slides as Financial Times Reports on Cash Advances
data.description: Worldline fell as much as 20% after the Financial Times reported on cash advances and the company’s internal actions in the years before 2023, according to Bloomberg.

data.title: Société Générale Expects Fed to Raise Rates Twice by 25 Basis Points in 2027
data.description: Société Générale expects the Federal Reserve to raise rates twice more in 2027, by 25 basis points each, according to its 2027 outlook. According to Odaily, the bank also projects a European Central Bank terminal rate of 2.75% and a U.S. 10-year Treasury yield of 4.51%.

data.title: AI TRENDS | Tencent WorkBuddy Launches Computer-Control Feature
data.description: Tencent's WorkBuddy has launched a computer-control feature that can recognize client interfaces and perform actions such as clicking, typing, and scrolling without requiring software to provide an API. According to PANews, citing WorkBuddy's official WeChat account on November 20, the feature is in public beta for macOS and Windows and requires client version 5.11.0 or later, along with accessibility and screen-recording permissions. Users can monitor task progress in a picture-in-picture window, and actions involving submissions require user confirmation. The company said interface-recognition performance varies by software.

data.title: 2027 Crypto Market: 10 Predictions Include Bitcoin Record High and $1 Trillion in Prediction Market Volume
data.description:
21shares has issued 10 predictions for the crypto market in 2027. According to Odaily, the firm expects Bitcoin to reach a new all-time high without reaching the current cycle’s peak, and annual prediction market trading volume to exceed $1 trillion.

The predictions also include: 15 G20 members having formal digital asset regulatory frameworks by the end of 2027; stablecoin monthly active addresses exceeding 100 million; RWA and fintech businesses increasing their share of DeFi revenue from about 8% to 15%; RWA spot and perpetual futures trading volume rising from $6.3 trillion in 2026 to $15 trillion; on-chain options volume exceeding $100 billion; privacy assets’ total market capitalization growing from about $31 billion to more than $100 billion; and broader adoption of on-chain finance by AI agents in 2027. The firm also expects exchanges and custodians to potentially move at least 50,000 BTC to addresses with hidden public keys in response to potential quantum computing risks.

data.title: London Cocoa Premium Over New York Widens Ahead of EU Deforestation Rules
data.description: According to Bloomberg, London cocoa futures are trading at a widening premium to New York as traders prepare for impending European Union deforestation rules that threaten to tighten bean supplies to the bloc.

data.description: According to Jin10, Alphabet (GOOG.O) filed pricing term sheet documents for a four-tranche notes offering totaling C$6 billion.

data.title: AgiBot and Lens Technology Deploy Dozens of Genie G2 Robots on Phone Testing Line
data.description: According to ChainCatcher citing Yicai, AgiBot Robotics and Lens Technology have reached a strategic partnership and deployed dozens of AgiBot Genie G2 robots on a mobile phone testing production line, reporters learned on November 20. The robots are handling tasks including loading and unloading test stations and interacting with testing equipment. The deployment covers phone MMI, ANT, CAM, and CAMCV testing, where roles involve repetitive operations and frequent model updates. AgiBot Robotics previously deployed robots at Longqi’s Nanchang factory.

data.title: UK and EU Reach Post-Brexit Deal Package, but Tuition Fee Dispute Remains
data.description:
According to Sina Finance, the United Kingdom and the European Union have agreed on a series of deals to deepen post-Brexit ties, though they remain divided over tuition fees. The agreements are intended to facilitate food trade, link their carbon markets, and allow young people to live, work and study in the other party’s country. A UK official said the timing of the agreements’ implementation would be set out in an upcoming joint statement.

Finalizing the post-Brexit agreements was a main goal of Friday’s summit in Brussels between UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham and EU leaders. A last-minute impasse over tuition fees raised questions about whether implementation could be delayed. The EU has sought local-student tuition rates for EU students studying in the UK.

The core elements of the agreements had been widely disclosed during months of negotiations, which were delayed after Burnham’s predecessor, Keir Starmer, resigned. Burnham said the agreements could increase UK economic output by 0.4%.

data.title: Saudi Arabia and Japan Agree on Crude Stockpile, Storage Expansion
